hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | grep -qE '(rm[[:space:]]+-rf|git[[:space:]]+push[[:space:]].*--force)' && { echo 'Blocked: destructive command (rm -rf or git push --force) is not allowed.' >&2; exit 1; } || exit 0

file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$file" in worker/*.py|worker/**/*.py) echo 'NOTE: worker lint/typecheck wires in at Phase 2 (uv run ruff check --fix && uv run pyright on edited file).' ;; api/*.py|api/**/*.py) echo 'NOTE: api lint/typecheck wires in at Phase 10.' ;; esac
file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$file" in web/*.ts|web/*.tsx|web/**/*.ts|web/**/*.tsx) echo 'NOTE: web typecheck (pnpm tsc --noEmit) and biome wire in at Phase 15.' ;; esac
